question: How much wall time does the unchanged real 17-coordinate cell_epoch launch require when run alone on cloned post-sham states, without neighboring CNS work?
protocol: Run one original sham ms without observation, capture the final cell_epoch argument tuple read-only, then run three isolated same-snapshot clone launches. Reset event/output buffers on each clone. No replay outputs are fed back into the organism.
interpretation: GPU event timing must be no greater than enclosing synchronized host wall (allow 1ms overhead jitter); otherwise attribution is invalid. Isolated post-state timing is not necessarily the fraction of the original coupled run.
